milestone: ALPINE RUSH — Work ski game integrated into Go Out Activities

ski.name: Alpine Rush
ski.entry: Go Out > Activities > Ski Resort > Enter Alpine Rush

rules: The existing Ski Resort card remains inside the Activities category
Enter & Play for Ski Resort is intercepted by an additive module and opens the completed Alpine Rush Work site
Drive Here keeps the original Go Out driving flow
Alpine Rush opens in a fullscreen in-game iframe overlay and includes an external-window fallback if the site blocks embedding
Closing Alpine Rush returns the player to the same Go Out Ski Resort detail view
No Fishing, Kitchen, Racing, supermarket, cafe, wardrobe, task, pet or other established gameplay is rewritten
next: Validate Alpine Rush iframe behavior in StackBlitz; if the Work host blocks framing, keep the same Ski Resort entry and use direct full-window launch/return flow instead
